with.script:
# The short-window editor matrix exercises the real software keyboard. Hosted
# API 35 headless AVDs can leave that IME suppressed, so make the software-IME
# contract explicit and prove a default method is ready before instrumentation.
adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings put secure show_ime_with_hard_keyboard 1
test "$(adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings get secure show_ime_with_hard_keyboard | tr -d '\r')" = 1
for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do default_ime=$(adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings get secure default_input_method | tr -d '\r'); if [ -n "$default_ime" ] && [ "$default_ime" != null ] && adb -s emulator-5554 shell ime list -s | tr -d '\r' | grep -Fx "$default_ime"; then exit 0; fi; sleep 1; done; exit 1
cd apps/android && ./gradlew :healthmd-core:connectedDebugAndroidTest :app:connectedFdroidDebugAndroidTest :app:connectedPlayDebugAndroidTest --stacktrace
cd apps/android && ANDROID_SERIAL=emulator-5554 HEALTHMD_ANDROID_E2E_HOST=10.0.2.2 ./scripts/run-direct-cli-ui-e2e.sh
